name: Truck
overview: It is about a football veteran who works on a cargo truck for a while and gets involved in adventures after meeting three students whose landlord has thrown their furniture out onto the street due to some problems. Saber, Vahid and Ashkan are three students whose landlord has thrown their furniture out onto the street due to some problems. Nader and the students get to know each other, and this acquaintance sets the stage for various events in the course of the story.
